# ComplaintCA

> ComplaintCA is a free, independent Canadian civic platform that helps people file a complaint with the right authority — municipal, provincial or federal — in English, French, Turkish, Chinese, Spanish, Arabic and Punjabi. It routes each complaint to the correct regulator, ombudsman, tribunal or school board, drafts the letter for the person to review, sends it, and gives a tracking number.

Key facts:
- Free for the people who use it. Not a law firm; it does not give legal advice.
- Authorities, deadlines and contacts come from a manually verified reference table or official public datasets (for example, the Ontario Ministry of Education school directory). AI helps classify the complaint and draft the letter; the authority for each category is always taken from that verified table.
- Coverage: all provinces and territories. Ontario school complaints are routed to the school and its school board.
- Other tools: find your MP/MPP/MLA, cyber crime reporting, scam document checks, access-to-information requests, and a Case Pool where partner lawyers see anonymized cases with similar CanLII decisions.
- Contact: complaintcaca@gmail.com

## Main pages
- [File a complaint](https://www.complaintca.ca/): start a complaint with the ASYA assistant.
- [All guides](https://www.complaintca.ca/guides/): where to complain, by province and by topic.
- [Blog](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/): data and news on complaint backlogs, fraud and consumer rights in Canada.
- [About](https://www.complaintca.ca/about.html): mission, verification, funding and independence.

- [Insurance Final Position Letter: How to Get One in Canada](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/insurance-final-position-letter-canada.html): Your insurer's Final Position Letter is the key to a free GIO review. What it is, how to ask for it, a sample request, and what to do if it never comes.
- [GIO Canada: How to Complain to the General Insurance OmbudService](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/gio-general-insurance-ombudservice-canada.html): GIO is Canada's free ombudsman for home, auto and business insurance disputes. What it covers, the step you must take first, and how to file.
- [Car Insurance Cancelled in Ontario? Your Rights and Next Steps](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/car-insurance-cancelled-ontario.html): Got a cancellation notice from your auto insurer? What insurers can and can't do in Ontario, how to complain to GIO and FSRA, and how to stay insured.
- [Chargeback Denied in Canada? 3 Ways to Still Get Paid](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/chargeback-denied-what-next-canada.html): Card issuer refused your chargeback? Ask for a review, escalate to the free banking ombudsman (OBSI), or go after the merchant directly.

- ["gov-refund.com" Scam: Fake Tax Rebate Site Warning](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/gov-refund-scam-domain-alert-2026.html): "gov-refund.com" and its "tax-rebate2024" subdomain are not Government of Canada sites. It was registered a day before people searched it. Check any link.

- [Mail Stolen or Cheque Cashed? What to Do in Canada](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/mail-theft-stolen-cheque-canada.html): Stolen mail or a cheque cashed by someone else? Call your bank first, then Canada Post, police and the CAFC. Steps, phone numbers and your rights.

- [Client Won't Pay an Invoice? How to Get Paid in Canada](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/recover-unpaid-invoice-canada.html): Client won't pay your invoice? Send a demand letter (sample wording inside), charge interest the right way, then go to small claims court. Deadlines inside.
- [How to Report a Teacher to the School Board](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/report-a-teacher-canada.html): How to report a teacher or principal to the school board in Canada, step by step. For misconduct, report to a regulator like the Ontario College of Teachers.

- [School Complaint Not Resolved? Superintendent to Ombudsman](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/school-principal-complaint-ontario.html): Principal didn't fix it? Escalate to the superintendent, the director and the Ontario Ombudsman, and use Education Act s. 300.3 to get answers in writing.

- [Canada Student Loan RAP: Pay $0 a Month If You Qualify](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/student-loan-repayment-assistance-canada.html): Can't afford your Canada Student Loan payment? The Repayment Assistance Plan can drop it to $0. Income limits, how to apply with NSLSC, and who to call.
- [Telecom Complaints in Canada Are Up 61%](https://www.complaintca.ca/blog/telecom-complaints-rising-2026.html): Telecom complaints in Canada rose 61%, with billing still #1. See which providers get the most complaints and how the free CCTS process works.
